description: Get detailed information about a specific media block including its properties, methods, events, input/output pads, constructor parameters, and documentation. Use this to understand how to configure and use a specific media block in a pipeline.

blockName.description: Name of the media block (e.g., 'H264EncoderBlock', 'RTSPSourceBlock', 'MP4SinkBlock'). Can be the short name or full qualified name.

name: get_media_block_info
